```{=html}
<svg class="aav-fig" viewBox="0 0 1000 460" shape-rendering="geometricPrecision" role="img"
     aria-label="Two panels. A: TLR2 sits in the plasma membrane of a Kupffer cell and binds the intact capsid, signalling through MyD88 to NF-kappa-B and the cytokines TNF-alpha, IL-6 and IL-1 beta. B: TLR9 sits in the endosomal membrane of a plasmacytoid dendritic cell facing the lumen, binds unmethylated CpG in the released single-stranded DNA, and signals through MyD88 to IRF7 and the type I interferons.">
  <defs>
    <marker id="aav-ah-tlr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="var(--aav-muted)"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ============================ PANEL A ============================ -->
  <text class="aav-fig-letter" x="18" y="30">A</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-title" x="40" y="30">TLR2 &#8212; CELL SURFACE</text>

  <!-- blood above, cell below; the boundary between them is the membrane -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="468" height="108" rx="24" fill="var(--aav-blood)"/>
  <rect x="16" y="150" width="468" height="286" rx="22"
        fill="var(--aav-paper)" stroke="var(--aav-ink)" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="32" y="70">blood, sinusoid lumen</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-end" x="468" y="142">plasma membrane</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="32" y="176">cytoplasm &#8212; Kupffer cell, endothelium</text>

  <!-- intact capsid, held by the receptor -->
  <g transform="translate(250 76)">
    <path d="M0,-24 L20.8,-12 L20.8,12 L0,24 L-20.8,12 L-20.8,-12 Z" fill="var(--aav-vector)"/>
    <path d="M0,0 L0,-24 M0,0 L20.8,12 M0,0 L-20.8,12"
          stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.42" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/>
  </g>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="292" y="72">intact capsid</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="292" y="88">VP1 / VP2 / VP3</text>

  <!-- TLR2 ectodomain cupping the capsid; TIR stub inside the cell -->
  <path d="M236 152 C 224 128, 228 108, 242 102" fill="none"
        stroke="var(--aav-innate)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M264 152 C 276 128, 272 108, 258 102" fill="none"
        stroke="var(--aav-innate)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="234" y="148" width="32" height="16" rx="5" fill="var(--aav-innate)"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-end fill-innate" x="204" y="122">TLR2</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-end" x="204" y="140">binds capsid protein</text>

  <path d="M250 168 V 190" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-tlr)"/>

  <rect x="192" y="194" width="116" height="38" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="250" y="218">MyD88</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="318" y="218">adaptor</text>

  <path d="M250 234 V 258" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-tlr)"/>

  <rect x="192" y="262" width="116" height="38" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="250" y="286">NF-&#954;B</text>

  <path d="M250 302 V 326" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-tlr)"/>

  <g class="aav-fig-cyto">
    <rect x="116" y="330" width="88" height="30" rx="15"/>
    <rect x="212" y="330" width="76" height="30" rx="15"/>
    <rect x="296" y="330" width="88" height="30" rx="15"/>
  </g>
  <text class="aav-fig-chip aav-fig-mid" x="160" y="350">TNF-&#945;</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-chip aav-fig-mid" x="250" y="350">IL-6</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-chip aav-fig-mid" x="340" y="350">IL-1&#946;</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="250" y="388">inflammatory alarm, raised by the</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="250" y="404">outside of the particle</text>

  <!-- ============================ divider ============================ -->
  <path d="M500 22 V 436" stroke="var(--aav-rule)" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ============================ PANEL B ============================ -->
  <text class="aav-fig-letter" x="522" y="30">B</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-title" x="544" y="30">TLR9 &#8212; ENDOSOME</text>

  <rect x="518" y="46" width="468" height="390" rx="26"
        fill="var(--aav-paper)" stroke="var(--aav-ink)" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="536" y="70">plasmacytoid dendritic cell</text>

  <!-- endosome -->
  <circle cx="672" cy="152" r="76" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-ink)" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="672" y="102">endosome lumen</text>

  <!-- uncoating capsid: same hexagon, stroked not filled -->
  <g transform="translate(634 154) scale(0.78)">
    <path d="M0,-24 L20.8,-12 L20.8,12 L0,24 L-20.8,12 L-20.8,-12" fill="none"
          stroke="var(--aav-vector)" stroke-width="3.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- released ssDNA carrying unmethylated CpG -->
  <path d="M654 154 q 9 -13 18 0 t 18 0 t 18 0" fill="none"
        stroke="var(--aav-vector)" stroke-opacity="0.75" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <g fill="var(--aav-innate)">
    <circle cx="663" cy="148" r="3.4"/>
    <circle cx="681" cy="148" r="3.4"/>
    <circle cx="699" cy="148" r="3.4"/>
  </g>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="636" y="250">capsid opens, ssDNA released</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid fill-innate" x="636" y="266">unmethylated CpG</text>

  <!-- TLR9: ectodomain in the lumen, TIR stub in the cytosol -->
  <path d="M746 140 C 726 132, 714 144, 710 152" fill="none"
        stroke="var(--aav-innate)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M746 164 C 726 172, 714 160, 710 152" fill="none"
        stroke="var(--aav-innate)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="744" y="136" width="16" height="32" rx="5" fill="var(--aav-innate)"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead fill-innate" x="772" y="148">TLR9</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="772" y="166">faces the lumen</text>

  <path d="M752 172 C 752 214, 752 226, 752 264" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2"
        fill="none" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-tlr)"/>

  <rect x="694" y="268" width="116" height="38" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="752" y="292">MyD88</text>

  <path d="M752 310 V 332" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-tlr)"/>

  <rect x="694" y="336" width="116" height="38" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-ink)" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="752" y="360">IRF7</text>

  <path d="M752 376 V 394" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-tlr)"/>

  <g class="aav-fig-cyto">
    <rect x="658" y="398" width="88" height="30" rx="15"/>
    <rect x="754" y="398" width="88" height="30" rx="15"/>
  </g>
  <text class="aav-fig-chip aav-fig-mid" x="702" y="418">IFN-&#945;</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-chip aav-fig-mid" x="798" y="418">IFN-&#946;</text>
</svg>
```
